text:
marta: Quick sync — RFC review tomorrow 2pm PT. Authors are Priya, Sam, and Jen. I want to confirm pre-reads are up and get final slot order. Can reviewers volunteer slots?

kai: I can review. Prefer to take an early slot (first or second). Need the pre-read pushed by EOD today so I can skim.

priya: Uploaded the PR + doc: https://git.company/repo/rfcs/pr-428 — added a short TL;DR and design rationale. Will add test plan section by 6pm.

sam: small follow-up pushed to the PR (fixes some naming and an example). Would prefer to go right after Priya if possible — then we can cover overlap.

jen: I can take the last author slot. Also happy to cover rollout/infra questions.

marta: Thanks. So tentative order: Priya -> Sam -> Jen. Kai will be primary reviewer/timekeeper. @calendar-bot can you update the meeting description with links and the ordering?

calendar-bot: Event updated: "RFC Review — 2pm PT"; description now contains PR links and ordering. Reminder set 30m before.

kai: Confirmed. I'll enforce 15/10/15 mins with a 10m buffer at the end. Authors: please add 3 takeaways and 2 open questions in the doc so reviewers can focus.

priya: Added takeaways and two open Qs under top-level SUMMARY. Also left a short perf table in the appendix.

sam: Done — added the example run and one open question about cache invalidation.

marta: Quick checklist before EOD: 1) Authors update docs (links in thread) ✅ 2) Add takeaways + open Qs ✅ 3) Reviewers confirm slots (kai ✅, others pls react) 4) Timekeeper assigned (kai ✅) 5) I'll post final agenda in the meeting thread 30m before.

jen: Reacted with :thumbsup:. Can someone paste the short agenda I'll use for notes?

marta: Agenda (final):
- 2:00 — Quick context + goals (marta, 2m)
- 2:02 — Priya (15m) — design walk, key tradeoffs, open Qs
- 2:17 — Sam (10m) — implementation notes, example, open Qs
- 2:27 — Jen (15m) — rollout & infra, dependencies
- 2:42 — Cross-review Qs & decision/next steps (10m)

kai: Perfect. I'll drop timestamps in the calendar event and mute notifications for ppl in flow.

priya: One ask — would reviewers prefer a short checklist to mark pass/follow-up? I can add a tiny template: `Summary / Risks / Followups` with quick bullets.

marta: Yes please — that will speed decisions. Priya, add it under the doc's REVIEWER_HELPERS heading.

sam: FYI I rebased the branch once more; doc link unchanged.

marta: Final note — if anyone absolutely can't make the slot, ping me and we'll reorder. Otherwise I'll mark this confirmed. Thanks all. :sparkles:
